provenance: Original CC0 orchestral MusicXML retained byte-for-byte; separately licensed analytical lyric nodes omitted before conversion.
Custom MIDI bypasses articulate playback; source transpositions, including double bass and C horns, remain active. No register-derived part splitting.
Repeat order is a candidate to be inspected against audio harmonic/recurrence diagnostics; duration is not independent evidence of repetition.

bars.description: Quarter-note pickup, then scherzo and trio with its written repeat: first pass through first ending, repeat starts on the trio upbeat within bar140, then second ending and written-out quiet scherzo return. XML split measures1/141/142/162 are implicit; no inserted padding rests.
